service.name: XC-9000 HTTP API
service.description: Complete XC-9000 HTTP API Documentation - Version 1.6

jsondata.description: JSON string with request parameters (empty object)

res.description: Result code, 1 for success, 0 for failure

member.description: Comma separated list of IP terminal IDs

show_type.description: Display type (0: All, 1: Online only, 2: Offline only)

state.description: Terminal type (-1: Offline, 0: XC type, 1: NAS type, 2: SIP type)

volume.description: Various volume types separated by commas

task.description: Terminal task status (0: Idle, 1: Talkback, 2: Monitor, 3: Broadcast)

target.description: Target terminal(s), separated by - if multiple

extdata.description: Data to return to third party platform

tbctlevel.description: Terminal priority for receiving broadcast, default 4

ttalklevel.description: Terminal priority for receiving call, default 3

tbctlist.description: Allowed terminal broadcast initiators (* means all)

ttalklist.description: Allowed terminal call initiators (* means all)

tmonlist.description: Allowed terminal monitoring initiators (* means all)

tmeetinglist.description: Allowed terminal conference initiators (* means all)

triggers.description: List of triggers separated by '|' and fields separated by '*'

commands.description: List of actions separated by '|' and fields by '*'

triggers.description: List of triggers separated by '|' and fields separated by '*'

commands.description: List of actions separated by '|' and fields by '*'

responses.description: Result of starting schedule task manually
Result of stopping schedule task manually

unformat.description: 1 means do not process uploaded audio files; any other value means converting format

request_body.example: Upload file using multipart/form-data, with optional subpath and unformat

responses.description: Result of uploading media file and returned filename

filename.description: File name to be deleted, prefix with '\' e.g. '\bangbang.mp3'

id.description: Terminal ID; null to update all

Result of setting extended text info for terminals

responses.description: Result of uploading extended picture info
